I was feeling blue, but I'm better now.

10 Seconds: The Pain Begins. 15 Seconds: You Can’t Breathe. 20 Seconds: You Explode.

You'll believe it when you see it!

TALK ABOUT T.N.T! THIS is IT!

On a magical Greek island a soldier is about to discover that it is better to make love instead of war

John met the woman of his dreams. Then he met her son...

Vive La Coolest Cat Who Ever Captured The Happy Heart Of Paris!

She fought for her mate with a tigress' fury…

Sudden, Outrageous, Global Celebrity has a price tag.

In 1980's Brooklyn, The Most Dangerous Gangsters Were New York City Cops.

Which one will you go see first?
Celia Teasdale / Sylvie Bell / Irene Pridworthy / Rowena Coombes / Josephine Hamilton
Toby Teasdale / Miles Coombes / Lionel Hepplewick / Joe Hepplewick

The Coup Arose In The North.

This Better Be Some Saturday Night!

Self - Porn Industry Advocate / Director of Public Affairs, FSC

31595: Lorsque vous rencontrez Réjean, (Rémy Girard) il est impossible de séparer le monde réel de son imaginaire. Biographe de métier, son rôle est d’embellir la vie de ses clients. Hésitant, il commence à raconter sa vie à la caméra. Tant bien que mal, il essaye désespérément de reconstruire sa vie tel qu’il s’en souvient. Malheureusement, sa profession déteint sur sa propre histoire. Pris au jeu, il choisira la facilité en se cachant derrière sa technique, pour faire de sa vie une aventure rocambolesque digne d’un auteur à succès. Une histoire à la fois drôle et poignante remplie d’intrigues où le spectateur tentera de discerner le vrai du faux. Y’en aura pas de facile.

Suddenly a scream pierces the air...and you're shocked to discover it's yours!
Jean-Loup Gabert, inspecteur stagière de Grazzi

Sonya Derringer, the woman giving birth

The men of the flying forts whose bravery became a legend

It's not nice to fool with Mother Nature... it can be HORRIFYING!

M.G.M. presents a Great Drama of Flaming Frontiers !

What You Can't See Can Hurt You

The picture that leaps ahead of the headlines!

The future is riding on one woman

François de Neufville, Duke of Villeroy

The President of the United States

An Ancient Game Becomes A Deadly Sport.

Two deadly weapons. Burning lips! ... Hot lead! ...

He's a one man army. She's a one woman death squad.

What if all your lies became reality?

Based on the terror that has shocked the nation!

He chased her . . . 'til she caught him!

Rage and intolerance collide with compassion

No Rig Was Too Big For Them To Handle!

He's back from the dead with a message from hell!

The Original Adventure To A World Like No Other
